model: Qwen3-30B-A3B BF16, 48 layers, H=2048 F=768 E=128 K=8

checks.owner_partial_checks: 24 exact BF16 owner-partial comparisons per rank, in addition to 720 recorded cases
checks.final_snapshot_recheck: H100 unittest 30/30 and EP=2 NCCL 720 cases per rank passed after final source/doc synchronization

path2.tp_replica_counting: only global ranks 0 and 2 count request sequences
path2.expanded_run_status: stopped after real-model smoke counterexamples; no 32x64 native-A2A acceptance claimed

benchmarks.statistic: one block per variant: warmup 3, repetitions 10, median of per-iteration maximum rank CUDA Event time
benchmarks.initial_target_gpu_utilization: 0%; other GPUs on the node had active workloads
benchmarks.conclusion: return payload is halved; no stable end-to-end speedup established, default remains FP32

runs.name: gpu1-bench-128-bf16-fused
runs.workload: synthetic seeded EP with distinct source tokens per rank
runs.statistic: median of per-iteration maximum rank CUDA event time; per-stage maxima need not add to total
runs.communication_bytes_note: actual_payload_bytes_by_rank counts each rank's forward and return sends, including padding/self and excluding count exchange. logical_sent_bytes_per_rank attributes the round trip to source tokens; return uses bf16; forward branch weight bytes=4

limitations: Full 32x64 validation is EP=2 only. EP=4 has NCCL kernel/layout coverage and short real-model backend/reduction comparisons.
Local FP32 owner reduction is validation-only; no full-corpus or production rollout acceptance.
FP16 here is transport dtype with BF16 model weights/activations, not an FP16 model.
No overlap claim or Nsight Systems timeline result; no async/pipeline change.
Throughput/timing of full-model validation is not a performance benchmark.

evidence.notes: Full per-layer JSONL and native baseline logits remain on H100 shared storage; local archive excludes the large baseline tensors.
